svg.text: A flat frame the shape of the shell rim: outside 64 x 52 with 4 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corners, inside 60 x 48 with 2 mm corners, 2 mm wide.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print 1.2 mm thick (six 0.2 mm layers) flat on the bed, slowly.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The three shell screws squeeze it to about 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lay it on the front shell rim before the rear shell goes on;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its inside edge lines up with the inside of the walls.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it lies flat on the rim with no twist or gap.
